highlights.title: Protests erupt after ICE shooting in Texas
highlights.summary: Protests have broken out in Austin, Texas, after a US Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer shot and wounded a man during a traffic stop. highlights.title: Challenges to Identity, Real and Imagined, Drive Europe’s Far Right
highlights.summary: The populist emphasis on national identity and pride, rather than the sins of the past, finds a deep response in voters adrift in a world they no longer understand.
